title: GetReservationEnquiryData
description: GetReservationEnquiryData schema from Quandoo Public Partner API

id.description: The agent-dependent unique id of the reservation enquiry

merchantId.description: The ID of the merchant at which this reservation enquiry was made

customerId.description: The ID of the customer to which this reservation enquiry belongs

capacity.description: The capacity (people count) of the reservation enquiry

startDateTime.description: The start date time of the reservation enquiry. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ

endDateTime.description: The end date time of the reservation enquiry. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ

status.description: The status of the reservation enquiry which can be one of:  NEW, IN_PROGRESS, ACCEPTED or REJECTED
